searchText: Hi, is it possible to view what was the eth1_withdrawal_address from beaconcha.in website? <https://beaconcha.in/validator/107239#deposits> https://github.com/gobitfly/eth2-client-metrics-exporter Metrics exporter for Nimbus + Prysm, docker images to come Intended use case was the beaconcha.in mobile app, but feel free to use it for something elese Notice that the withdrawal credentials is not the withdrawal address but its hash Huh? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/validator.md#eth1_address_withdrawal_prefix If it's an eth1 withdrawal address it contains the address itself. yeah right... I should say: high chances that it's a hash instead of an address 🙂 ohh I misread the question, I didn't see specifically asked for eth1 addresses yes, I also researched it a bit. if it starts with `0x01...` it is an eth address. otherwise, it is bls withdrawal prefix. they are hashed so it is not possible to tell the original address.
